top_signals.title: Oil Swings on Russia-Ukraine Progress, Saudi Attacks
top_signals.summary:
US equity futures waver ahead of earnings season with the US Treasury market closed for the holiday. Oil swings after President Trump said Kyiv and Moscow had agreed to an “energy ceasefire,” while President Zelenskyy says Russia has breached the truce. Saudi Arabia suffered its deadliest strikes since the Iran war began.  Divya Singaravelu of Meridian 1305 Capital joins "Bloomberg Brief" to discuss the outlook for the 10-year Treasury yield. Josef Aschbacher, Director General of the European Space Agency, speaks to Bloomberg's Oliver Crook at the Warsaw Security Forum. Stella Li, Executive Vice President of BYD, speaks to Bloomberg's Caroline Connan about the automaker's expansion into Europe at the Paris Auto Show.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Microsoft to rely more on homegrown AI chips, reducing dependence on Nvidia
top_signals.summary: By increasingly counting on its own chips, Microsoft stands to expand margins and bolster its AI stack.

top_signals.title: Gramercy-Backed Firm Fends Off Ouster From $36 Billion Lawsuit
top_signals.summary: A Gramercy Funds Management-backed law firm was unlawfully fired from a $36 billion lawsuit that has seen two private credit investors clash over who will represent hundreds of thousands of victims of a dam collapse in Brazil.

top_signals.summary: "Starbucks is not buying Chipotle," a Starbucks spokesperson told CNBC.
